title: Miss Maria Ivanovna Sepanenko, Russian

page_data.en:
F.M. 2
G. 55M-1 38

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No............
Section 1, Special Branch ............ 18464,
REPORT
Date August 23, 1938

Subject Communication dated 15-8-38 from the Netherlands Consulate-General
concerning Miss M.I. Stepanenko.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by [Signature]

Miss Maria Ivanovna STEPANENKO, Russian, born on July 8,
1909 at Harbin. She arrived in Shanghai in November, 1930 from
Harbin where, according to her own statement, she had worked in
a pharmacy for a short period as an apprentice pharmacist.
In Shanghai she is reported to have been employed as a dancing
partner in the Del Monte Cafe. For the past few years she appears
to have been cohabiting with a certain Dr. Karl Elster, M.D.,
an Austrian or German of Jewish origin, who has his offices at
170 Kiangsi Road ( Hamilton House) and resides at 1202 Avenue
Joffre.

It is believed that after a short stay with friends in the
Netherlands Indies Miss Stepanenko will join Dr. Elster in Hong-
kong where their marriage is planned to take place, after which
they will return to Shanghai.

Miss Stepanenko's father is reported to have left Harbin
for the U.S.S.R. in 1922 and her mother, Mrs A.V. Krotoff, divorcee,
resides at 172 Rue Amiral Courbet.

Miss Stepanenko is registered with the Russian Emigrants'
Committee, 118 Moulmein Road.

Nothing detrimental is known by this office regarding her.

A. Prokofiev
D. S. I.

[Handwritten note:]
24/8

D. C. ( Special Branch)

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案号............
特务科第1组 ............ 18464，
报告
日期：1938年8月23日

事由：荷兰总领事馆于1938年8月15日来函，涉及 M.I. Stepanenko 小姐。

由特别调查员 Prokofiev 呈报。转呈人 [签名]

Maria Ivanovna STEPANENKO 小姐，俄国人，1909年7月8日出生于哈尔滨。据其自述，她曾在哈尔滨一家药房短期担任药剂师学徒，后于1930年11月从哈尔滨抵达上海。
据悉，她在上海期间曾受雇于德尔蒙特咖啡馆（Del Monte Cafe）担任舞伴。过去几年间，她似乎与一位名为 Karl Elster 的医学博士同居。Elster 博士系犹太裔奥地利人或德国人，其诊所在江西路170号（汉密尔顿大厦），寓所位于霞飞路1202号。

据信，Stepanenko 小姐在荷属东印度群岛的朋友处短暂停留后，将前往香港与 Elster 博士会合，计划在那里举行婚礼，随后返回上海。

据悉，Stepanenko 小姐的父亲已于1922年离开哈尔滨前往苏联；其母亲 A.V. Krotoff 女士（离异）现居住于古拔路172号。

Stepanenko 小姐已在莫尔尼路118号的俄国侨民委员会登记。

本局未掌握任何关于她的不利记录。

A. Prokofiev
特别调查员

[手写批注：]
8月24日

副巡官（特务科）

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.
No.2449.
SHANGHAI, 25th August 1938.
8683

Sir,

I wish to acknowledge the receipt of your letter
No.D.8683 dated the 24th instant regarding Miss Marie Ivanovna
Stepanenko and to thank you for the information contained
therein.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

Consul-General.

The Deputy Commissioner
Special Branch, Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No.2346.
SHANGHAI, 15th August 1938.

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that Miss Marie Ivanovna
Stepanenko has applied to this Consulate General for a visé for
admission into the Netherlands Indies.

Miss Stepanenko is in possession of a registration certi-
ficate issued by the Police of the French Concession on the 4th
February 1938, under No.911.

According to this certificate she was born at Harbin on
July 8th, 1909, her profession stated to be a pharmacist.

She intends to visit some friends in the Netherlands Indies
and in case a visé will be granted to her she will apply for
a passport with the Nansen Immigrant Committee.

Her residence is at 1202 Avenue Joffre, apartment 56.

I should be greatly obliged to you if you would let me know,
if possible, whether anything is known against this person from
a political or moral point of view.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

Consul-General.

The Deputy Commissioner
Special Branch, Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

（批：DBR. 17/8. P. A. to D. C. (Sp. Br.)）
（批：8/12 O.S.S. Protokoll 17/8）
page_data.zh:
荷兰驻华中总领事馆
电报挂号：HOLLANDIA。

第2346号。
上海，1938年8月15日。

先生：

谨此通知，Marie Ivanovna Stepanenko 小姐已向本总领事馆申请进入荷属东印度群岛的签证。

Stepanenko 小姐持有法租界巡捕房于1938年2月4日签发的登记证，编号为911。

根据该证书，她于1909年7月8日出生于哈尔滨，职业注明为药剂师。

她打算前往荷属东印度群岛拜访朋友，若获发签证，她将向南森移民委员会申请护照。

她的住址是霞飞路1202号56室。

如蒙告知是否从政治或道德角度掌握对此人不利的情况，本人将不胜感激。

此致
敬礼

总领事

上海公共租界工部局警务处
特务科副巡官
上海。

（批注：DBR. 8月17日。呈副巡官（特务科）阅办）
（批注：8/12 O.S.S. Protokoll 8月17日）
